name: VIX-Gold Risk Filter on NASDAQ
description: Claims to beat NASDAQ buy-and-hold using only statistical correlations between VIX and gold — no indicators, no price action. Mimics buy-and-hold in bull markets but 'generates alpha through downturns' by sidestepping them.

setup.description: Hold QQQ by default. Go flat when the regime is risk-off: VIX above its moving average AND gold outperforming QQQ over the momentum lookback (flight-to-safety confirmation from two independent stress signals).

entry.long: Risk-on: VIX below its MA, or gold not leading equities

exit.flat: Risk-off: VIX elevated AND gold momentum > QQQ momentum

notes: Video is specific about inputs (VIX + gold vs NASDAQ) but silent on exact rules; this is a faithful minimal interpretation. Implemented as strategy-studio BUILTIN 'vix_gold_filter' (not a video: cache module) so it gets walk-forward, the risk engine, and benchmark overlays — the right tooling to test a 'beats buy-and-hold' claim. Interpreted in-session by Claude (pipeline ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unset).
